title: Notes app ideas
body:
Every view is a query over the same notes.
- Smart folders = saved filters
- Counts update without refetching
- Optimistic edits, roll back if the server says no
- Analytics page: words per folder, edits per day

title: Weeknight shakshuka
body:
Serves 2, about 25 minutes.
# Ingredients
[ ] 1 onion, 1 red pepper
[ ] 2 garlic cloves
[ ] 1 tin chopped tomatoes
[ ] 4 eggs
[ ] Cumin, smoked paprika, chilli flakes
[ ] Feta and parsley to finish
# Method
Soften the onion and pepper, add spices and garlic, then tomatoes. Simmer 10 minutes, make wells, crack in the eggs, cover until the whites set.

title: Sourdough schedule
body:
Feed the starter at 9:00, it doubles by about 14:00.
- 14:00 mix flour and water, rest 1 h
- 15:00 add starter and salt
- Stretch and folds every 30 minutes, four sets
- Shape at 20:00, cold proof overnight
- Bake 250 °C lid on 20 min, lid off 25 min

title: Latency experiment
body:
Add 2 s of fake latency and see if typing still feels instant.
If the UI waits on the network, the user notices. If it applies the change locally first, they don't.

title: Architecture notes: sync
body:
Server is the source of truth. Clients keep a local copy and apply writes optimistically.
- Each mutation gets a transaction id
- When the server confirms, drop the optimistic state
- If it rejects, roll back and show why
Open question: how do we show conflicts to the user?
